PasswordResetCode.title: Password Reset Code
PasswordResetCode.description: Temporary short-lived 6-digit verification code used for in-modal password resets.

email.description: User email address requesting password reset

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the code was created

expiresAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds after which the code expires

used.description: Flag indicating if the code has already been verified and used

/password_reset_codes/{codeId}.description: Stores short-lived password reset codes keyed by normalized email address
